Aisha (Finance): Heads-up: small billing updates being published today. Summary: 72-hour overage grace for metered accounts, slight free-tier rate-limit increases, and new short-lived promo credit policy for credits issued after rollout. Full doc linked below.

Tom (Eng): Where will the grace show up in the API?

Aisha (Finance): We'll add a header X-Redwood-Grace: true/false and a webhook field grace_window_expires_at.

Riley (Support): Invoice visibility?

ops-bot: Invoice example will include a line item "Grace window protection" and show any tokens/units excluded from billing during the grace period.

Aisha (Finance): Free-tier RPS: text 2->4, embeddings 1->2. Promo credits issued after rollout expire in 180 days (existing credits unaffected).

Tom (Eng): Rolling this out in stages?

Aisha (Finance): Yes: internal docs + API schema today, Console UI next week, customer emails 7 days prior. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/update-2026
